title: Project Manager III
description:
Title: Project Manager III
Location: Philadelphia, PA
Type: Contract

Our client is seeking a Project Manager III who will plan and manage business projects to ensure they are completed on time, meet the needs of the client, and stay within budget.


Key Accountabilities:
  • Determines what the client or company wants to achieve.
  • Creates timelines; and determines costs and resources needed.
  • Generates a detailed plan and schedule for each stage of the project.
  • Selects supporting staff and lead a project team.
  • Negotiates with contractors and suppliers for materials and/or services.
  • Ensures that each stage is progressing on time, on budget, and to the processes and quality standards of the company.
  • Reports the project progress to senior managers and the client.
  • Manages risks and manage to avoid delays.
  • Coordinates and monitors the scheduling, pricing, and technical performance of company programs.
  • Aids in the negotiation of contracts and contractual changes and coordinating preparations of proposals, plans, specifications, and financial conditions of contracts.
  • Develops new business and expands product line.
  • Ensures adherence to master plans and schedules, develops solutions to program problems, and directs work of incumbents assigned to program from various departments.
  • Acts as advisor to program team regarding projects, tasks, and operations.
  • Relies on extensive experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals.


Required Skills:
  • Requires a bachelor's degree and at least 5-8 years of experience in the field or in a related area.
  • Familiar with standard concepts, practices, and procedures within the field.
  • Excellent planning and organization skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced multi-priority environment.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to problem-solve and implement actionable steps.
  • A certain degree of creativity and latitude is required.
